title: TRIM removes leading and trailing spaces and repeated spaces between words
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", TRIM ( "  DAX   is  awesome  " ) )

source.quote: Removes all spaces from text except for single spaces between words.
TRIM removes trailing and starting spaces from a string
source.supports: the example comment: also multiple spaces within the string

derivation: The two leading and two trailing spaces go; the runs of 3 and 2 spaces between the words become single spaces: "DAX is awesome".
